hero.headline: Your research projects, from idea to publication
hero.support: Plan proposals, collaborate with your team, run experiments, and keep publications in one clear workspace.

steps.title: Propose
steps.body: Describe your scientific goals, planned experiments, and related work in a clear proposal.

steps.title: Review
steps.body: Submit for scientific review and follow the decision until your project is accepted.

steps.title: Experiment
steps.body: After acceptance, choose instruments available for your work and run your experimental campaign.

steps.title: Publish
steps.body: Record the publications that come out of the campaign and close the project when you are done.

benefits.title: Built for research teams
benefits.body: Lead a project as principal investigator, or join as a collaborator with the right level of access.

benefits.title: One place for the full story
benefits.body: Keep proposal, experiments, and publications together so nothing gets lost between tools.

phases.title: Before acceptance
phases.body: Build your science case: write the proposal, invite your team, plan experiments, and link related publications.

phases.title: After acceptance
phases.body: Run the campaign on the instruments you need, track resulting publications, and mark the project complete.

capabilities.title: Projects & team

capabilities.title: Proposals

home.ctaSupport: Create an account to manage your projects, or learn more about the journey from proposal to publication.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.intro: ResearchHub walks you from a research idea to a finished campaign — propose, get reviewed, experiment, and publish.

phases.title: Before acceptance
phases.body: Prepare everything the reviewers need: objectives, proposal text, planned experiments, related publications, and your team.

phases.title: After acceptance
phases.body: Once accepted, schedule and run experiments, add publications from the campaign, and complete the project when the work is done.

steps.title: Create and prepare
steps.body: Start a project, write your proposal, invite collaborators, plan experiments, and link related publications.
items: Define objectives and expected results
Plan the experiments you intend to run
Link related publications
Invite editors and viewers by email

steps.title: Submit for scientific review
steps.body: When the proposal is ready, submit it. Reviewers assess your science case and decide whether to accept it.
items: You submit when the proposal feels complete
You can follow progress while it is under review
Acceptance unlocks the next stage of work

steps.title: Start experimental work
steps.body: After acceptance, schedule and run experiments using the instruments available for your project.
items: Choose instruments for each experiment
Move from planning into real campaign work

steps.title: Run the campaign
steps.body: Continue experiments and record the publications that come from this project’s work.
items: Keep experiment records up to date
Add resulting publications
Complete the project when the campaign finishes

steps.title: Close the project
steps.body: The campaign is finished. You can still attach resulting publications if needed.
items: Project work is closed
Publications from the campaign remain available to add

roles.title: Owner
roles.body: Creates the project, invites the team, and has full control over the work.

roles.title: Editor
roles.body: Helps write the proposal, experiments, and publications, and can submit or complete the project.

roles.title: Viewer
roles.body: Follows the project with read-only access.

documentation.title: Learn more
documentation.intro: A short overview of what ResearchHub offers researchers — from your first account to a completed project.

sections.title: Create an account
sections.body: Register with your email and password, then sign in whenever you want to work on your projects.
items: One account for your research workspace
Secure sign-in with your email

sections.title: Work on projects with your team
sections.body: Each project brings together overview, team, proposal, experiments, and publications in one place.
items: See all your projects on the dashboard
Open a project and switch between its sections easily

sections.title: Invite collaborators
sections.body: Owners invite colleagues by email as editors or viewers. Guests accept from Invitations after signing in with the same email.
items: Invitations are time-limited
Access starts only after the invitation is accepted

sections.title: Write and submit proposals
sections.body: Capture your methodology and expected results, then submit for scientific review when you are ready.
items: One proposal per project
Clear path from draft to review to acceptance

sections.title: Plan and run experiments
sections.body: Describe what you plan to do, then after acceptance schedule and record runs on instruments offered for your work.
items: Plan early, execute after acceptance
Pick the instrument that fits each experiment

sections.title: Track publications
sections.body: Link related work while preparing the proposal, then add publications that result from the campaign.
items: Related work early in the journey
Campaign outputs once experiments are underway

sections.title: Follow the full cycle
sections.body: Every project moves through a clear journey: draft, review, acceptance, active work, and completion.
items: You always know where the project stands
Each stage unlocks the right next actions

sections.title: What happens after you submit?
sections.body: Your proposal enters scientific review. If it is accepted, you can start experimental work. If it is not, the campaign does not move forward.
items: Acceptance opens experiments and campaign tracking
You stay in control of team and project details throughout

register.title: Register

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Overview of your projects and invitations.

projects.subtitle: Projects you own or collaborate on.

draftPrep.title: Prepare your project
draftPrep.intro: Complete these steps before submitting for scientific review. After submit, you cannot add planned experiments or related publications while waiting for a decision.
draftPrep.rejectedIntro: This project was rejected. Revise your proposal and related draft content using the review comment, then submit again.
draftPrep.rejectedNote: Revise using the review comment below, then continue through the steps and submit again.
draftPrep.checklistTitle: Check what you have prepared, then submit for review.
draftPrep.freezeWarning: After you submit, your project enters scientific review. You will not be able to add or edit planned experiments or related publications until the project is accepted.
draftPrep.confirmMessage: Submit this proposal for scientific review? You will not be able to change planned experiments or related publications while waiting for a decision.

experiments.title: Experiments
experiments.emptyPlannedEditable: Add planned experiments for the proposal.
experiments.emptyExecutedEditable: Add the first executed experiment to start the project.
experiments.hintPlanned: While the project is a draft, you can add planned experiments for the proposal.
experiments.hintExecuted: After approval, add executed experiments. The first one moves the project to in progress.
experiments.hintNoAdd: Experiments cannot be added in the current project status.

publications.title: Publications
publications.emptyExistingEditable: Link existing or related publications to the proposal.
publications.emptyResultingEditable: Add publications that result from this project's work.
publications.hintExisting: While drafting, link existing or related publications to the proposal.
publications.hintResulting: Once work is underway, add publications that result from this project.
publications.hintNoAdd: Publications cannot be added in the current project status.

invitations.title: Invitations
invitations.subtitle: Accept or decline project invitations for your email.
